WITH
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
offsets AS (
     SELECT SEQUENCE(0, 4 * 30 - 1) AS quarter_offsets
),
quarters AS (
     SELECT x,
            DATE_ADD('quarter', -x, current_fq_start) AS start_date
       FROM offsets
 CROSS JOIN UNNEST(quarter_offsets) AS t(x)
 CROSS JOIN (
             SELECT CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6   THEN DATE_PARSE(CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || '-04-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
                         WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9   THEN DATE_PARSE(CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || '-07-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
                         WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN DATE_PARSE(CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || '-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
                         ELSE DATE_PARSE(CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AS VARCHAR) || '-01-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
                    END AS current_fq_start
            )
),
final AS (
     SELECT start_date,
            DATE_PARSE(
                CAST(YEAR(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) AS VARCHAR) || '-' ||
                LPAD(CAST(MONTH(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' ||
                LPAD(CAST(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) IN (1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12) THEN 31
                        WHEN MONTH(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30
                        ELSE CASE 
                                 WHEN YEAR(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) % 400 = 0 OR 
                                      (YEAR(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) % 4 = 0 AND YEAR(DATE_ADD('month', 2, start_date)) % 100 <> 0)
                                 THEN 29 ELSE 28 
                             END
                    END AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'
                ),
                '%Y-%m-%d'
            ) AS end_date,
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(start_date) >= 4 THEN YEAR(start_date) + 1
                ELSE YEAR(start_date)
            END AS fiscal_year,
            1 + ((MONTH(start_date) - 4 + 12) % 12) / 3 AS fiscal_quarter,
            'FY' || 
            CAST(
                CASE 
                    WHEN MONTH(start_date) >= 4 THEN YEAR(start_date) + 1
                    ELSE YEAR(start_date)
                END AS VARCHAR
            ) || 'Q' || 
            CAST(1 + ((MONTH(start_date) - 4 + 12) % 12) / 3 AS VARCHAR) AS fiscal_year_quarter
       FROM quarters
), 
fiscal_quarters AS (
     SELECT fiscal_year_quarter,
            fiscal_year,
            fiscal_quarter,
            CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS start_date,
            CAST(end_date   AS DATE) AS end_date
       FROM final
      ORDER BY start_date DESC
),
fx_rates_usd_to_cad AS (
       SELECT business_date                                         AS business_date,
              CASE
                WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1 / mid_price
                ELSE mid_price
              END                                                   AS exchange_rate
         FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE from_currency   = 'USD'
          AND to_currency     = 'CAD'
          AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
          AND mid_price      != 0
          AND rate_type_code  = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_usd_to_local AS (
       SELECT business_date                                         AS business_date,
              from_currency                                         AS from_currency,
              to_currency                                           AS to_currency,
              CASE
                WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1 / mid_price
                ELSE mid_price
              END                                                   AS exchange_rate
         FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE from_currency   = 'USD'
          AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
          AND mid_price      != 0
          AND rate_type_code  = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_cad_to_local AS (
       SELECT usd_to_cl.business_date                               AS business_date,
              'CAD'                                                 AS from_currency,
              to_currency                                           AS to_currency,
              ROUND(
                usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate,
                8
              )                                                     AS exchange_rate
         FROM fx_rates_usd_to_local usd_to_cl
   INNER JOIN fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
           ON usd_to_cl.business_date = usd_to_cad.business_date
        UNION
       SELECT business_date                                         AS business_date,
              'CAD'                                                 AS from_currency,
              'USD'                                                 AS to_currency,
              exchange_rate                                         AS exchange_rate
         FROM fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
),
private_real_estate_model_portfolios AS ( -- "private" model portoflios that are actually part of listed portfolio 
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Private Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND mp.model_portfolio_id                 IN  ('RIALIA02', 'RIFLAM', 'RIESRKS', 'RIRELCP', 'RIUNITE')
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Infrastructure'                              AS investment_group,
            'Listed Infrastructure'                       AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Sustainable Energies'                        AS investment_group,
            'Listed Sustainable Energy Group'             AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT *
       FROM private_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.*
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.elementary_transaction_code   IN ('Buy', 'Sell' ,'CapRed', 'BuyRaloc', 'SellRaloc')
        AND t.model_portfolio_id            IN (SELECT model_portfolio_id FROM listed_real_assets_model_portfolios)
),
finance_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            t.abor_transaction_number,
            CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) AS period_closure_date,
            CAST(ft.business_date AS DATE)      AS business_date,
            CAST(t.trade_date AS DATE)          AS trade_date,
            t.elementary_transaction_code       AS elementary_transaction_code,
            ft.debit_amount_quotation_currency  AS buy_amount_in_local,
            ft.debit_amount_portfolio_currency  AS buy_amount_in_cad,
            ft.credit_amount_quotation_currency AS sell_amount_in_local,
            ft.credit_amount_portfolio_currency AS sell_amount_in_cad,
            ft.debit_credit_portfolio_currency  AS debit_or_credit
       FROM abor_transactions t
 INNER JOIN finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions ft
         ON t.scd_transaction_number_primary_key  = ft.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
      WHERE ft.abor_finance_account              IN ('1400-0000-021', '1421-0000-021', '1423-0000-021')
),
buys_and_sells_per_quarter AS (
     SELECT t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            q.fiscal_year,
            q.fiscal_quarter,
            q.fiscal_year_quarter,
            q.end_date,
            CAST(SUM(t.buy_amount_in_local) AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS gross_invested_equity_current,
            CAST(SUM(t.buy_amount_in_cad)   AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            CAST(SUM(t.sell_amount_in_cad)  AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS permanent_roc_historical
       FROM fiscal_quarters q
  LEFT JOIN finance_transactions t
         ON t.period_closure_date <= q.end_date
   GROUP BY q.fiscal_year,
            q.fiscal_quarter,
            q.fiscal_year_quarter,
            q.end_date,
            t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id
)

    h.balance_number_of_units,

    sp.party_name AS issuer_party_name,

    s.abor_security_id,
    s.abor_strike_price,

    mp.investmentstructurelevel2,
    mp.investmentstructurelevel3,
    mp.investmentstructurelevel4,
    mp.investmentstructurelevel5
FROM 
    (SELECT *
     FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main 
     WHERE business_date = '2025-03-31' 
       AND portfolio_id != 'LOOK THRU'
       and abor_security_id='ODF29 COMDTY'
       AND abor_security_type_name IN (
            'IRS Interest Rate',
            'Credit Default Swap',
            'FX Forward',
            'FX Non Deliverable Forward',
            'Bond Future',
            'Commodities Futures',
            'OTC Swaptions - Purchased',
            'OTC Swaptions - Written',
            'Equity Future',
            'Options-Exchange Trade-Bond',
            'OTC Warrant',
            'Listed Warrant',
            'Interest Rate Future',
            'Options-Exchange Traded-Commodity',
            'Options-OTC-Credit',
            'Options-Exchange Traded-Interest Rate',
            'Options-OTC-Equity',
            'Options-Exchange Traded-Equity',
            'Options-OTC-Vanilla FX'
        )
    ) h
LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT *
     FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date)
                            FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
       AND investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24') mp
    ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT *
     FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date)
                            FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)) mport
    ON h.model_portfolio_id = mport.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT *
     FROM reference.scd_portfolio
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date)
                            FROM reference.scd_portfolio)) port
    ON h.portfolio_id = port.portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT *
     FROM reference.scd_securities
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date)
                            FROM reference.scd_securities)) s
    ON h.abor_security_id = s.abor_security_id
LEFT join
	(select *
	from asset.enterprise_security_composite
	WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date)
							from asset.enterprise_security_composite)) es
    ON h.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM party.party_ratings
    WHERE rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
    and business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date)
      						FROM party.party_ratings)) AS pr

         from holdings.certificate_deposit_holdings_details

         ) as a
    left Join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
          document_type,
          instrument_description,
          cusip ,
          isin,
          sedol,
          ticker,
          issue_date ,
          bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange ,
          bloomberg_unique_id ,
          coupon_rate ,
          coupon_type ,
          coupon_frequency_code,
          maturity_date,
          country_code as mds_country_code,
          exchange_name,
          region_code,
          market_sector_description,
          issue_country_iso,
          callable_flag,
          next_coupon_date,
          first_coupon_date,
          issue_date,
          par_amount,
          exchange_name,
          bloomberg_exchange,
          next_call_date,
          mic,
          issue_price,
          delete_date,
          cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new
          from asset.asset_money_market
          where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
         ) as b
     on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new   
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
          party_name, 
          bloomberg_company_id, 
          domicile_country_code,
          incorp_country_code
          from party.party
          where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
         ) as d
     on b.cppib_party_id_new=d.cppib_party_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new3,
          cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,
          cppib_currency_code ,
          cppib_currency_of_exposure_code

          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_4
          from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
          where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
         ) as e
     on b.cppib_sec_id_new=e.cppib_sec_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          country_code,
          country_name
          from reference.reference_country_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
         ) as f
     on e.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=f.country_code
    left join
         (select
          currency_code,
          currency_name
          from reference.reference_currency_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
         ) as g
     on e.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=g.currency_code
    left join
         (select

     id_model_portfolio, 
     unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
     from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
     where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
          ) as h
     on a.id_model_portfolio = h.id_model_portfolio
     left join
          (
               select rating_agency,rating_value,rating_type,rating_date,CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new4
               from radar_reporting_dev.cppib_party_rating
               where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-06-20'
               and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
          ) as i
     on d.cppib_party_id_new3 = i.cppib_party_id_new4  
     left join
          (select
           CAST(cppib_party_id AS int) as party_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
           cppib_country_of_exposure_code as party_cppib_country_of_exposure_code
          from party.party_enterprise_classification
          where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
          )  as pr
     on pr.party_cppib_party_id = cast(b.cppib_party_id_new AS int)

FROM (WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation

        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,

            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),

        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'

                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,

            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1

        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,

            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,

            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans

    performance AS(

    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_qc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance QC"

       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent

LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code

LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id) AS "Holdings"

          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')

               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'

                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'

SELECT
	from_currency
	,to_currency
	,mid_price
	,business_date
	,inverse_quoted
FROM
(
	SELECT
		from_currency
		,to_currency
		,CASE
			WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
			ELSE mid_price
		END as mid_price
		,business_date
		,'N' as inverse_quoted
	FROM
		"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
	WHERE
		(
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CAD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
		)
		OR
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='GBP'
			AND to_currency IN ('EUR'))
		)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		t_usdrates.to_currency as from_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.to_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.mid_price/t_usdrates.mid_price as mid_price
		,t_usdcadrate.business_date
		,t_usdcadrate.inverse_quoted
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code = 'SR'
			AND from_currency = 'USD'
			AND to_currency = 'CAD'
	) t_usdcadrate
	INNER JOIN
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
	) t_usdrates
	ON t_usdrates.business_date = t_usdcadrate.business_date
	AND t_usdrates.from_currency = t_usdcadrate.from_currency
) t_rates
WHERE business_date BETWEEN date('2025-06-23') AND date('2025-06-23')

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-14')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-14')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code

FROM (WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

FROM (WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,

        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day

    0 AS "ITD Net Return -TWR QC",
    0 AS "ITD Gross Return - TWR QC",
    0 AS "ITD Net Return - wgt'd avg. price QC",
    0 AS "ITD Gross Return - wgt'd avg. price QC",
    0 AS "ITD Net Return -Annualized-TWR QC",
    0 AS "ITD IRR QC",
    0 AS "ITD Net PnL PC",
    0 AS "ITD Gross PnL PC",
    0 AS "ITD Net Return -TWR PC",
    0 AS "ITD Gross Return - TWR PC",
    0 AS "ITD Net Return - wgt'd avg. price PC",
    0 AS "ITD Gross Return - wgt'd avg. price PC",
    0 AS "ITD Net Return -Annualized-TWR PC",
    0 AS "ITD IRR PC",
    perf.payments_quotation_currency,

    perf.reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
    calc.gross_div_pc                                                                AS "Gross Dividend PC",
    calc.gross_div_qc                                                                AS "Gross Dividend QC",
    calc.div_taxes_pc                                                                AS "Dividend Taxes PC",
    calc.div_taxes_qc                                                                AS "Dividend Taxes QC",
    calc.net_purchase_qc                                                             AS "Net Purchase QC",
    calc.purchase_cost_qc                                                            AS "Purchase Cost QC",
    calc.net_purchase_pc                                                             AS "Net Purchase PC",
    calc.purchase_cost_pc                                                            AS "Purchase Cost PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_pc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc                                                                 AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc                                                                AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_qc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase QC",
    calc.net_sell_qc                                                                 AS "Net Sell QC",
    calc.total_cap_qc                                                                AS "Total Capital QC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_qc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance QC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id) AS "Holdings"
LIMIT 1000

FROM (WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

SELECT
    CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)                                              AS "Business Date",
    regional_classification_name                                                     AS "DM/EM",
    sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4                                       AS "Sector",
    holding.abor_security_id                                                         AS "Ticker",

    holding.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Cost QC",

    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                                          AS "BB Unique ID",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))                         AS "Bloomberg Code",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",
