,date_format(date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11)),'%d/%m/%Y') AS "Maturity_Date"
,DATE_DIFF('day',l.business_date,date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11))) AS "Term_To_Maturity"
,CASE 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Equity' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'IRS IR' THEN
    case when esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' then 'Fixed' else 'Floating' end
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Credit' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF')
AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Base' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Price'

       from_currency_code,
       to_currency_code,
       mid_value,

FROM (

)

       price_source_code,
       cast(cppib_security_id as integer) as cppib_sec_id,
       rate_type,
       from_currency as from_currency_code,
       to_currency as to_currency_code,
       mid_val as mid_value,
       cast(settlement_date as varchar) as settlement_date,
       inv_quoted_flag as inverse_quoted_flag,

       chron_id as derived_from,
       'Y' as stale

                  where business_date = (select max(business_date) from radar_reporting_prod.fact_fx_rate

			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,

                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,

                ) as currencyToCadRate

				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

    select business_date, pos_id, 
    case when mapping_method = 'ARS_Mapping' then LTR_PV / 3 
         else LTR_PV 
    END LTR_PV from (
        select business_date, pos_id, mapping_method, sum(weight*final_value) LTR_PV
        from radar_reporting_prod. fact_pos_ltr_mapping
        where business_date = '2025-06-20'
        group by business_date, pos_id, mapping_method
    )
),
fact_fx as (
    select fact_fx.chron_id, pos_id, fact_fx.business_date, sum(final_value) FX_PV from
        radar_reporting_prod.FACT_POS_CALC_FXEXP fact_fx
    left join radar_reporting_prod.DIM_CALC_CURRENCY currency 
        on currency.chron_id = fact_fx.chron_id and currency.business_date = fact_fx.business_date
        and fact_fx.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
    where fact_fx.calc_type = 'FXREP_EXPOSURE_CURRENCY'
    and fact_fx.business_date = '2025-06-20'
    group by fact_fx.chron_id, pos_id, fact_fx.business_date 
),
PV_recon as (
    SELECT 
    business_date,  chron_id, pos_id,pos_short_desc, hierarchy_mp,
    split(node_path, '|')[2] AS fund,
    split(node_path, '|')[3] AS dept, 
    split(node_path, '|')[4] AS strategy, 
    split(node_path, '|')[5] AS program,
    STSECURITYID,murex_reference_id,murex_contract,isin,cppib_security_id,
    RM_PV,
    abacus_pv_base_ccy radar_pv,
    abacus_accrued_interest_pc accrued_interest,
	abacus_pv_local_ccy,
	abacus_notional_base_ccy,
    cppib_product_type
    from  (
    SELECT d.chron_id,d.pos_id,d.business_date,pos_short_desc,m.model_portfolio hierarchy_mp,abacus_notional_base_ccy,
    CASE WHEN d.m_nb IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('MX', d.m_nb) 
        WHEN d.holkeyik IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('SC', d.holkeyik) END AS STSECURITYID, murex_reference_id,murex_contract,isin,cppib_security_id,
        f.RM_PV, f.abacus_pv_local_ccy ,f.abacus_pv_base_ccy, f.abacus_accrued_interest_pc, f.run_id, d.mpdefs_mp, h.node_path, h.node_level,
        d.cppib_product_type
    FROM  radar_reporting_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd F
    INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_pos_inst d ON F.chron_id = d.chron_id AND F.pos_id = d.pos_id AND F.business_date = d.business_date 
    LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod. mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk m ON d.chron_id = m.chron_id AND d.business_date = m.business_date and d.PTFL_ACCT_CODE=m.model_portfolio 
    LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod. dim_hierarchy_node h on  m.dim_hierarchy_node_id=h.dim_hierarchy_node_id and h.node_level = 6
    WHERE d.portfolio_type='IP'
    and d.business_date = '2025-06-20'
    )
    order by business_date, dept, strategy, program
),
rmv as (
  select distinct
        scd_model_portfolio,product_group, inst_inst_type, maturity_date, position_key,
        case when rm_pv is not null then rm_pv end rm_roundtrip_pv,
        case when rm_pv is null then 
             case when abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0.0 then abacus_pv_base_ccy else null end
        end rm_discard
    from radar_reporting_prod.rmv_position
    where
    business_date = '2025-06-20'
    and portfolio_type='IP'
)

    pos_id,
    radar_pv,
    accrued_interest,
    RM_PV_ RM_PV, 
    LTR_PV_ LTR_PV,
    FX_PV_ FX_PV,
    RM_Roundtrip,
    Rndtrp_discard

from (
    select

        murex_reference_id,murex_contract,isin,cppib_security_id,maturity_date,abacus_pv_local_ccy,
        abacus_notional_base_ccy,

        radar_pv/1000000  radar_pv,
        accrued_interest/1000000  accrued_interest,

        FX_PV/1000000 FX_PV_,
        rm_roundtrip_pv/1000000 RM_Roundtrip,
        rm_discard/1000000 Rndtrp_discard
    from PV_recon d 
    left join fact_fx on fact_fx.chron_id = d.chron_id AND fact_fx.pos_id = d.pos_id AND fact_fx.business_date = d.business_date
    left join ltr on ltr.business_date = d.business_date and ltr.pos_id= d.pos_id 
    left join rmv on rmv.position_key = d.STSECURITYID
    )

WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-20'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'

WITH max_business_date AS (
     SELECT as_of_date,
          id,
          max(business_date) bd
     FROM alternative_assets_qa.real_estate_yardi_investment_level_holdings
     GROUP BY as_of_date,
          id
),
quarter_end AS (
     SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
)
SELECT a.id AS "Deal ID",
     investment_name AS "Deal Name",
     a.as_of_date AS "Reporting End Date",
     local_reporting_currency AS "Deal Currency",
     SUM(equity_carrying_value_local_currency) AS "Carrying Value (Local)",
     SUM(unfunded_commitment_local_currency) AS "Cumulative_Unfunded"
FROM alternative_assets_qa.real_estate_yardi_investment_level_holdings a
     INNER JOIN max_business_date b ON (
          a.id = b.id
          AND a.as_of_date = b.as_of_date
          AND a.business_date = b.bd
     )
WHERE MONTH(a.as_of_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
     AND a.as_of_date <= (
          SELECT quarter_end_date
          FROM quarter_end
     )
     AND TRIM(LOWER(a.id)) IN ('ialpha','ijdv04','imsref7','ijdv03','ibsrep1','iscrp7','ibsrep2','iscrp6','iind03','ihraof','igood20','ibsrep7')
GROUP BY a.id,
     investment_name,
     a.as_of_date,
     local_reporting_currency
ORDER BY a.as_of_date
